_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Wires the rule engine into the bookkeeping lifecycle (REQ-RE-003). Adds the ARInvoice.issue precondition `OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\RuleComplianceGuard::validateInvoice`, which runs OCA\Shillinq\Standards\RuleEngine over the invoice and blocks the draft->issued transition when a MANDATORY machine-checkable invoice rule from the RuleCatalogue is violated (EN 16931 BR-02/03/05/13/14, BR-CO-15 total-with-VAT calculation, gl-sequential-invoice-numbering). The ARInvoice.issue transition has no prior `requires`, so this is a clean addition (deep-merge), not an override. GLTransaction.post enforcement is implemented in the same RuleComplianceGuard (::validateTransaction, reusing BalanceGuard for the balance invariant) and unit-tested, but its lifecycle wiring is deferred: GLTransaction.post already carries `requires: BalanceGuard::isBalanced` plus allocation-rule `actions`, and `requires` is single-valued, so wiring it requires overriding that scalar — held back until the fragment deep-merge is confirmed to preserve the existing `actions`. No new schema; this fragment only attaches a guard to an existing transition.
